$comment: Single source of truth for task routing. Read by route.mjs, task.mjs check, the validator and the docs table (docs/risk-and-approvals.md is generated from this file). Changing it is a governance change.

investigator.purpose: Root-cause analysis when the cause is unknown or uncertain; reproduces, traces, proves hypotheses.

architect.purpose: System boundaries, shared contracts, storage architecture; writes ADRs.

database-engineer.purpose: Schema, migration and data-change safety: locking, backfill, reversibility, validation.

platform-engineer.purpose: CI/CD, build, deployment, infrastructure and runtime configuration: diagnoses pipeline/deployment failures and plans infrastructure changes.

product-designer.purpose: UX/UI specification for significant interface work and review of the rendered result.

software-engineer.purpose: Implements the smallest correct change with tests.

verifier.purpose: Independently verifies acceptance criteria and regressions; proves regression tests fail before and pass after.

security-engineer.purpose: Threat-focused review of security-sensitive changes; verifies dependency-vulnerability exceptions.

senior-reviewer.purpose: Independent final review of the diff, root cause and evidence.

testing_levels.checks: Run the deterministic checks that cover the touched files (lint, format, build, link check). No new tests expected.
testing_levels.targeted: Run tests for the affected area plus new or updated tests for changed behaviour; a bug fix adds a regression test proven to fail before and pass after; run the full suite once before completion where feasible.
testing_levels.full: Full test suite, lint, type check and build, plus the domain checks each flag adds; rollback path verified or explicitly stated as not verifiable.

security.description: Authentication, authorisation, sessions, permissions, secrets, cryptography, untrusted input reaching a database/shell/filesystem/template, uploads, webhooks, personal or payment data, security controls, dependency vulnerabilities.
testing: negative and abuse-path tests for the affected control (unauthorised, invalid, missing, oversized input)

data-schema.description: Database schema changes, migrations, or changes to how data is stored.
testing: apply the migration and its rollback on a disposable database
verify existing data after migration

detect.text: \b(migrations?|database schema|schema change|alter table|add (a )?column|new column|drop column|rename column|foreign key|add (an )?index|new table)\b

data-destructive.description: Deleting, overwriting or irreversibly transforming stored data (drop, truncate, purge, destructive backfill).
testing: backup/restore or reversibility path demonstrated on a disposable copy

approvals.when: before executing the destructive operation against any non-disposable environment

architecture.description: Changes system boundaries, core patterns, service responsibilities, storage architecture or shared contracts; introduces a service, datastore or framework.
testing: contract or integration tests across the changed boundary

approvals.when: before implementation that depends on the proposed ADR

public-contract-breaking.description: A breaking change to a public API, event schema, SDK, CLI or file format that others consume.
testing: contract tests proving the new behaviour and the documented migration path

infrastructure.description: Build, container, deployment, infrastructure-as-code or runtime configuration.
testing: validate/plan/dry-run of the changed configuration (e.g. terraform plan, docker build, helm template)

ci.description: CI/CD pipeline definitions or CI-only failures.
testing: the pipeline (or its local equivalent) runs green on the branch

production.description: The task requires a production deployment or changes production configuration or data.
testing: smoke test plan for after deployment
rollback procedure written and checked

approvals.when: before any production deployment or production configuration change

hotfix.description: Urgent fix for a live problem; minimal change with a follow-up for anything deferred.
testing: targeted regression test plus smoke test of the affected journey

ui-significant.description: A new screen or flow, a redesign, or a change to navigation or the design system.
testing: rendered review of the changed screens at mobile and desktop widths (ui-review skill)

detect.text: \b(redesign\w*|new (screen|page|flow|wizard)|user flow|onboarding flow|ux|user experience|look and feel|design system|navigation overhaul)\b

testing: rendered check of the changed screen (screenshot or browser), or report the visual result as Not verified

api-change.description: Adds or changes an API endpoint, handler, message or contract without breaking consumers.
testing: API/contract tests for the new or changed behaviour, including error responses

dependency.description: Adds, removes or upgrades a dependency (minor/patch).
testing: ecosystem vulnerability scan (npm audit, pip-audit, cargo audit, …)
full test suite

dependency-major.description: A major-version or framework upgrade with breaking changes in the dependency.
testing: the dependency's migration guide checked item by item
full suite, build and smoke test

performance.description: A performance problem or regression, or a change made for performance.
testing: before/after measurement with the same method, data and environment

flaky-test.description: A test that passes and fails without code changes.
testing: repeated runs before and after the fix (at least 20, or the count that reproduced it)

client-specific.description: Behaviour required for one client, tenant or deployment rather than all users.
testing: tests proving the client-specific behaviour and that default behaviour for other clients is unchanged

multi-module.description: The change spans several modules or shared code others depend on.
testing: tests for each affected module's callers

root-cause-unknown.description: The cause of a defect is not yet established. The investigator diagnoses it, unless a flag already routes a specialist who diagnoses that domain (diagnoses: true).

requirements-ambiguous.description: Different reasonable interpretations would produce materially different results.

no-test-coverage.description: The affected area has no tests to detect a regression.

change.description: Change the system: fix, feature, refactor, configuration (default).

review.description: Review an existing diff, branch or PR; no implementation.

investigate.description: Diagnose and report; no fix requested.

always_gated.when: before pushing the task branch or opening a PR, unless the task request pre-authorises it
before merging, releasing or tagging (live approval only)

approval_actions.push: Push a branch or open a pull request on a remote.
approval_actions.deploy-production: Deploy to, or change configuration of, production.
approval_actions.destructive-data: Execute an operation that deletes or irreversibly changes non-disposable data.
approval_actions.irreversible-infra: Delete or de-provision infrastructure, or rewrite shared git history.
approval_actions.credential-operation: Create, rotate, revoke or move secrets and credentials.
approval_actions.security-control-weakening: Disable or weaken an authentication, authorisation or other security control, even temporarily.
approval_actions.external-service-change: Change a third-party service, paid resource or shared environment outside the repository.
approval_actions.breaking-change: Merge or release a breaking change to a public contract.
approval_actions.architecture-decision: Commit to an ADR with substantial long-term consequences.
approval_actions.scope-expansion: Expand work materially beyond the task request.
approval_actions.outside-repository: Act on files or systems outside the authorised repository.
approval_actions.vulnerable-dependency-exception: Introduce or keep a dependency with a known vulnerability.
